Title: “Holier Than Thou, Online”
Panel 1
A man posts: “Be kind to everyone 🙏”
Caption box:
8:01 AM
In the background, his coffee mug says “World’s Most Humble.”
Panel 2

Caption box:
8:02 AM
Panel 3
His friend looks over his shoulder and says, “Didn’t you just post about kindness?”

Panel 4

Some halos are just ring lights.
